!! Microsoft Data Engineer 2 Interview Experience !!

Interview Experience for a Data Engineer 2 role at Microsoft, and it was a deep dive into Big Data, PySpark, Data Warehousing, System Design, and DSA. Sharing key takeaways for those preparing for similar roles!

📌 Round 1: Big Data, PySpark & Data Warehousing
✅ PySpark Coding & Optimization
Jobs, stages, and tasks - performance tuning techniques
Efficient transformations (narrow vs. wide dependencies)
Broadcast joins vs. shuffle joins
Catalyst optimizer & Tungsten execution

✅ Hadoop Ecosystem
HDFS - block storage & replication
YARN - resource allocation & container management
MapReduce vs. Spark - when to use which

✅ Dimensional Modeling
Fact vs. Dimension tables, partitioning & indexing
Star vs. Snowflake Schema - trade-offs in query performance
SCD Type 2 Handling - tracking historical changes efficiently

📌 Round 2: Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA)
✅ Two LeetCode Medium Questions
Dutch National Flag Algorithm - sorting in-place using two pointers
Interval merging - optimizing from O(n log n) to O(n)

💡 Key Focus Areas
Start with brute-force, optimize iteratively
Discuss time & space complexity trade-offs
Use efficient data structures like heaps, hashmaps, stacks

📌 Round 3: System Design & Dimensional Modeling
✅ Data Pipeline Design
Batch vs. Streaming ingestion (Kafka/Spark Streaming)
Storage - Delta Lake, Parquet vs. Avro
Compute layer - Optimizing ETL with Spark
Query layer - Redshift/Snowflake tuning

✅ Dimensional Modeling Challenges
SCD Type 2, surrogate keys, and partitioning strategies
Minimizing shuffle operations for optimized queries

📌 Round 4: Managerial & Optimization Round
✅ Technical Deep Dive on Projects
✅ Query tuning, caching strategies, distributed processing
✅ CI/CD for Data Pipelines - Automating ETL workflows, deployment strategies
✅ Behavioral Questions - Adaptability, problem-solving, decision-making

💡 Key Takeaways:
🔹 PySpark performance tuning is crucial (jobs, stages, tasks)
🔹 Dimensional modeling expertise is a must!
🔹 Optimize code step by step, always move beyond brute-force
🔹 System design isn’t just about architecture - scalability & performance matter
🔹 CI/CD for data pipelines is becoming the industry standard
